text: PWR / PD — vertical USB-C; CH32X035 negotiates motor voltage on the dedicated input.
F1 protects the input; D_BLOCK limits reverse current; D_VM_TVS clamps VM transients.
R_PD_CC1 and R_PD_CC2 provide independent 5.1 kΩ Rd pull-downs while CC1/CC2 remain connected to U_MCU.
LOGIC POWER — diode-ORed VM or DATA USB 5 V is regulated to 3.3 V.
DATA / PROG — vertical USB-C for USB 2.0 programming/data and optional 5 V logic power.
Hold BOOT while connecting DATA / PROG to enter the ROM USB bootloader.
U_MCU negotiates PD and controls STEP, DIR, ENN, UART, and STDBY.
U_DRV — top-side TMC2209 with a plated-through thermal-via field.
UART changes run/hold current; the VREF network provides a hardware current ceiling.
MOTOR — 8HS15-0604S; JST pins 1-4: A+/BLK, A-/GRN, B+/RED, B-/BLU.
USB-C PD input and motor supply
